customManagers.description: the codex-lb stack runs our patched build, tagged <upstream version>-pr2692; track the upstream image so this tag moves in the same PR as the FROM line in stacks/codex-lb/Dockerfile

the hermes sandbox image is the upstream -desktop sandbox plus Chrome (stacks/hermes-sandbox/Dockerfile), tagged <upstream tag>-chrome; track the upstream image so the tag in stacks/hermes.yaml moves in the same PR as the FROM line
nod image tags in stacks/nod.yaml are the upstream version; .github/workflows/nod-images.yml builds them from release tag nod-v<version>

packageRules.description: nod images are built by CI from upstream releases; bumps come from the n8n-io/nod custom manager above, not docker tag lookups (a tag exists only after the bump is merged)

our codex-lb image is the upstream release plus a patch (stacks/codex-lb/Dockerfile) and is rebuilt by CI; upstream bumps arrive through the FROM line there and the codex-lb custom manager above, not docker tag lookups

our hermes-sandbox image is the upstream sandbox plus Chrome and is rebuilt by CI; upstream bumps arrive through the FROM line in stacks/hermes-sandbox/Dockerfile and the custom manager above, not docker tag lookups
Pin digests for rolling tags to track underlying image changes
Parse version from hotio images and preserve release- prefix
Extract version from text-embeddings-inference tags (compute-capability-version format, e.g. 86-1.9)
Major updates get their own PRs for review
Automerge nod patch and minor releases once the image build passes; nod is 0.x and ships features in patch releases, so its minors are treated like patches. Major bumps wait for review

CLIProxyAPI and Oh My CPA are tested together (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-26-cliproxyapi-gateway-design.md §6): OMC rewrites CPA's config, so bumps of either arrive as one reviewed PR, never automerged. Placed after the patch/minor/major rules so it wins
